text:
anya: Heads-up: onboarding sample (next + edge) broke on ESM edge builds. runtime says "Class extends value undefined" only after adapter bundling. Local node works.
anya: Minimal package.json + tsconfig in the repo.
anya: package.json:
```
{
  "name":"rw-onboard",
  "type":"module",
  "exports": { "import": "./dist/index.mjs", "default": "./dist/index.cjs" }
}
```
anya: tsconfig:
```
{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "module": "ESNext",
    "target": "ES2020",
    "moduleResolution": "bundler",
    "declaration": true
  }
}
```
chris: bundlers sometimes inline CJS compatibility wrappers. That can replace the export with undefined if require() is shimmed away. Do we have conditional runtime shims in the package?
anya: yes small shim that does: `module.exports = require('./index.cjs')` guarded by typeof exports check.
li: two problems we've seen: 1) shim injection breaks subclass prototype, 2) typing ergonomics - our SDK uses `unknown` generics and JS users lose inference.
oscar: quick fixes: for samples published for edge, make them ESM-only (no CJS default). For SDK surface, provide a JS-friendly overload. Eg:
```
request(path: string, body?: any): Promise<Record<string, any>>;
request<T = unknown>(path: string, body?: unknown): Promise<T>;
```
This gives good JS DX while keeping TS strict when users opt in.
chris: also try switching sample tsconfig.moduleResolution to node16; bundlers respect node16 exports resolution more predictably than bundler mode.
anya: tried enabling esModuleInterop which fixed runtime but broke a few overload inference tests in CI.
li: if esModuleInterop changes inference, prefer keeping it off and instead add small convenience helpers in SDK: `client.json<T>()` and `client.any()` so sample authors can call those for better auto-complete.
oscar: and remove CJS shim from edge sample to avoid potential polyfill pulls that reference `self` / globalThis fallbacks.
anya: plan: 1) update sample package.json to import-only ESM, 2) switch tsconfig to node16 resolution for sample, 3) add typed helper in SDK and sample README showing `await client.request<{embedding:number[]}>(...)` and `client.json` shorthand, 4) add small CI smoke job to run the ESM sample in vercel dev in PR checks.
chris: +1. devx-bot can we create a ticket for the CI job?
devx-bot: created issue #1302: "ci: smoke-test ESM-only edge onboarding sample in vercel dev" labels: devex/ci, priority/medium. Assigned to @anya.
anya: opening PR with the minimal changes and a unit test that asserts the exported class is constructible after bundling. Ping for review when ready.
li: thanks — include a tiny snippet in PR description showing improved IDE inference so reviewers can verify the typing change is intentional.
